responsibility: Defines and tests the hierarchical mod/ref tree data structure used to summarize memory accesses. It implements the templated base/reference nodes, insertion and merge behavior, collapse rules, and GGC/PCH hooks for the summary representation consumed by the modref analysis pass.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the out-of-line support code for the modref tree representation: selftests plus GGC/PCH marking hooks for modref_tree, base nodes, ref nodes, and access nodes. Unlike gcc/ipa-modref-tree.h, it does not define the reusable template API itself; it provides runtime support and verification for that representation.
